name: Aberrant Anatomy

source.note: Entered from published reviews and guides to Ravenloft: The Horrors Within (and Van Richten's Guide to Ravenloft, which it revises); compare every number with the book before setting checked_against.

summary: Ravenloft Dark Gift. Hold your breath for an hour, Expertise in Perception and Blindsight 15 feet; a natural 1 can leave you Stunned.

benefits.name: Aberrant Lungs
benefits.summary: You can hold your breath for 1 hour.
benefits.text: You can hold your breath for up to 1 hour.

benefits.name: Aberrant Senses
benefits.summary: Proficiency and Expertise in Perception; Blindsight 15 feet.
benefits.text: You gain proficiency in the Perception skill (or keep it), Expertise in it, and Blindsight with a range of 15 feet.

drawback.name: Drawback
drawback.summary: On a natural 1: Constitution save (DC 13 + PB) or Stunned until the end of your next turn.
drawback.text: Whenever you roll a 1 on the d20 of a D20 Test, you make a Constitution saving throw (DC 13 plus your Proficiency Bonus); on a failure you have the Stunned condition until the end of your next turn, as your body twists against itself.
